title: Billing Review Referral Card: Residential Electricity Supply Off-Peak Disputes
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply time-of-use agreement, a correction larger than the care agent's adjustment limit is not posted as a rebill credit but referred to billing review as one open billing dispute on the line, at the disputed amount determined for it rather than the bare over-billed amount. The dispute is opened on the off-peak energy line of the agreement with the largest billed amount.

**What the referral records.** A billing dispute in open status on the agreement, naming the disputed bill line and the disputed amount, recorded as a positive amount; billing review then settles it. Opening the dispute credits nothing on the bill.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Correction larger than the care agent's adjustment limit | One open billing dispute on the line |
| Line the dispute is opened on | The agreement's off-peak energy line with the largest billed amount |
| Sign of the disputed amount | Positive |

## Referral action

**Capability.** `open_billing_dispute_231feff0` refers one disputed Beacon Ridge electricity bill line to billing review by opening a billing dispute. A new billing dispute is created for the line, in open status, recording the agreement, the line disputed, the disputed amount and the moment of referral; billing review then settles it. Nothing is credited on the bill by this action.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `open_billing_dispute_231feff0` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number the disputed line belongs to, as read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `source_billing_id` | The reference number of the disputed bill line, as read from the bill-line lookup of the agreement | Identifier |
| `disputed_amount_usd` | The amount referred for review | Positive amount in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new dispute number, the agreement, the disputed line and the disputed amount in USD, and stating that the dispute is open. Receiving it means the referral is recorded.
